title: Rubric: Two-Shaft Plain Weave Shed Transition & Selvage Control

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-01
criteria.description: Step 1: Depress treadle #1 fully to separate odd and even warp threads into a clean 45mm open shed before throwing shuttle. [source_claim_id: CLM-01]
criteria.observable_indicator: Depress treadle #1 fully to separate odd and even warp threads into a clean 45mm open shed before throwing shuttle.

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-02
criteria.description: Step 2: The reed must beat the newly laid weft pick into the cloth fell only after the treadles alternate to lock the thread in place. [source_claim_id: CLM-02]
criteria.observable_indicator: The reed must beat the newly laid weft pick into the cloth fell only after the treadles alternate to lock the thread in place.
